Note: I left out the co-op claim ($117,436.88). The agreement says claims are due by January 31 following the Program Year and unclaimed funds expire, and the evidence shows claims closed 2026-01-31, which has passed. Dear Ashland Climate team,

Thank you for your continued partnership. In reconciling our program year, we found two items where we believe a credit is due, and we would appreciate your review.

1. Volume tier rebate: $222,418.33
The June 2025 amendment (ashland-climate-amendment-2025-06.pdf) reduces the third-tier threshold from $50,000,000 to $42,000,000, with rates unchanged. It also states that "the rebate rate for the highest tier achieved shall apply to all Eligible Purchases in the Program Year, from the first dollar." Our Eligible Purchases of $44,483,666.77 reach the 2.25% tier, which gives $1,000,882.50 earned. Against the $778,464.17 already paid or claimed, the balance is $222,418.33.

2. Freight prepaid: $7,690.88
Our distributor agreement states: "Orders of $5,000 or more ship freight prepaid to any Distributor location." We were billed for and paid freight on 53 orders of $5,000.00 or more, totaling $7,690.88, and have not yet been credited for it.

Please issue a credit memo for these amounts, or let us know if any supporting detail would help. We're happy to send order-level backup for the freight items.

Thank you for your help.

Purchasing, Hartwell Supply Co.

Our eligible purchases for the year came to $6,829,256.69, which reaches the 1.50% tier. We have already been paid or have previously claimed $25,438.85. That leaves a balance of $77,000.00.

We respectfully request a credit of $77,000.00 to our account for the remaining volume tier rebate. If your records differ from ours, please send us your calculation and we will gladly review it together.

Thank you for your help with this. We look forward to continuing to work with you.

Kind regards,

Purchasing, Hartwell Supply Co.
answers.letter:Northstar HVAC:9802102c95421070:
Dear Northstar HVAC team,

Thank you for your continued partnership. While reconciling our 2025 program rebates under northstar-hvac-program-2025.pdf, we found two amounts we believe are still due. We would appreciate a credit for each.

1. Volume tiers: $32,427.94
The agreement states: "Once a tier is reached, its rate is paid on every dollar of the year's qualifying purchases." Our eligible purchases of $6,608,038.45 reach the 2.25% tier, which applies from the first dollar. That earns $148,680.87. Of this, $116,252.93 has already been paid or claimed, which leaves $32,427.94.

2. Growth: $5,747.13
The agreement states: "An additional 1.0% is paid on the amount by which qualifying purchases exceed the distributor's total 2024 purchases from Northstar HVAC, net of returns." Our 2025 purchases of $6,608,038.45 compare with $6,033,325.60 in 2024. The 1% growth rebate on the difference is $5,747.13. Nothing has been paid or claimed on this yet.

Together, these come to a requested credit of $38,175.07.

If anything in our figures differs from your records, please send us your calculation and we will gladly review it together. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,

Purchasing, Hartwell Supply Co.

answers.letter:Vantel:77524f18c81044a6:
Dear Vantel team,

Thank you for your continued partnership. We would like to use our stock rotation right for this Program Year and ask for a return authorization.

Section reference, vantel-distributor-agreement.pdf: "Once each Program Year the Distributor may return current Products purchased within the previous eighteen (18) months, up to 5% of its prior Program Year's Eligible Purchases, for credit at the net price paid, less a 10% restocking charge."

Our calculation is as follows:
- Stock rotation allowance for the year: $294,509.37
- Already used: $49,010.45
- Remaining allowance: $245,498.92
- Stock received in the last 18 months and unsold all year: $374,558.20, which exceeds the remaining allowance, so we are limiting the return to the allowance
- Less the 10% restocking charge

This gives a credit of $220,949.02. Nothing has been paid or claimed against this amount previously.

Please send a return authorization for this return, along with shipping instructions, and confirm the credit of $220,949.02 once the goods are received. If you need a product list or any supporting detail, we will gladly provide it.

Thank you for your help.

Purchasing, Hartwell Supply Co.

---

Note: $245,498.92 × 0.9 is $220,949.028, which rounds to $220,949.03. I used $220,949.02, the figure in the evidence, so the letter stays consistent with your source. You may want to confirm which one to use.
answers.letter:Westerly Thermostats:d56839747af4:

We would appreciate a credit of $11,811.82 to our account for the growth bonus. If your records show a different purchase figure for either year, please send us your numbers and we'll reconcile them promptly.

Thank you for your help. We look forward to continuing to grow with Westerly in the year ahead.

Kind regards,

Purchasing, Hartwell Supply Co.
